units.source_text: 八亲王既逝世，此间不便留宿，薰君便准备回京。

en.t: Since the Eighth Prince had passed away, it was no longer proper to stay the night there, so Lord Kaoru prepared to return to the capital.

units.source_text: 他回想：“八亲王对我说‘与君相见，今日恐是最后一次了’，

en.t: He recalled, The Eighth Prince said to me, Meeting you today may well be the last time,

units.source_text: 我当时认为岂有此理，谁知果然不得再见。

en.t: At the time I thought such a thing could not possibly be true, but who could have known that I would indeed never see him again.

units.source_text: 那时是秋天，现在还是秋天，曾日月之几何，

en.t: It was autumn then, and it is still autumn now; how little time has really passed,

units.source_text: 而亲王已不知去向，人生实在虚幻无常啊！”

en.t: yet the prince has already gone somewhere beyond knowing. Human life is truly fleeting and uncertain.

units.source_text: 八亲王不像一般人那样爱好装饰，

en.t: The Eighth Prince had not cared for ornament as ordinary people often do,

units.source_text: 故山庄中一切都很简单朴素，

en.t: and so everything in the mountain villa was simple and plain,

units.source_text: 然而打扫得十分清洁，处处饶有清趣。

en.t: yet it was kept perfectly clean, and everywhere had a refined, quiet charm.

units.source_text: 现在常有法师出入，各处用帷屏隔开，

en.t: Now monks were constantly coming and going, and the rooms were partitioned here and there with curtains and screens,

units.source_text: 诵经念佛的用具依然保存着。

en.t: while the implements used for sutra chanting and Buddhist prayers were still kept in place.

units.source_text: 阿阇梨向两女公子启请：“所有佛像等物，请移供于山寺中。”

en.t: The acharya respectfully asked the two princesses, Please move all the Buddhist images and other sacred objects to the mountain temple and enshrine them there.

units.source_text: 薰君听了这话，设想这些法师也都要离去，

en.t: When Lord Kaoru heard this, he imagined that these monks too would all be leaving,

units.source_text: 此后这山庄中人影绝迹，留在这里的人何等凄凉！

en.t: and that from then on this mountain villa would be emptied of human presence; how lonely it would be for those left behind here.
He could not help feeling endless pain in his heart.

units.source_text: 随从人告道：“天色已很晚了。”

en.t: An attendant told him, It has already grown very late.
He had no choice but to get into his carriage with sorrow in his heart.

units.source_text: 适有鸣雁横空飞渡，便赋诗云：

en.t: Just then, crying geese flew across the sky, and he composed a poem:
